_note: Each key is a path prefix relative to the repo root; the array is the needles that path may legitimately contain. '*' allows every needle. tests/ is not scanned at all.

_reasons.app/Brand/Brand.php: Brand::fallback() is the DB-less boot path; config('app.name') is the genuine last resort and can never be resolved from the brand itself.
_reasons.app/Brand/BrandManager.php: The disabled branch must reproduce the pre-2.6 PDF author/footer byte for byte.
_reasons.app/Brand/BrandPalette.php: #09090b is the dark surface token, not a product name.
_reasons.app/Admin/Report/Pdf/PdfDocument.php: tempPrefix() falls back to the historic prefix when brand resolution is unavailable.
_reasons.app/Http/Controllers/Admin/BackupControl: A filesystem path prefix that must match spatie/laravel-backup's own config, not a brand string.
_reasons.resources/js/app.ts: Last-resort title fallback, reached only when the server emitted no brand meta.
_reasons.resources/views/brand/offline.blade.php: Dark-scheme surface colour in a static, pre-CSS file.
